Quick notes:

anyone can download the github and spawn a Voat server inside of a vagrant machine, and then set an active connection/bandwith limit and storage limit.

the voat load balancers will keep track of uptime, ping, loss, of these servers, and rank them accordingly. only making use of lower tier servers under heavy load.

pros:

  • never complete loss of service as long as the community stays behind the project.

  • way harder to target for cyber attacks.

  • way less cost to the admin, only hosting load balancers.

  • redundancy, most popular content gets moved to the most servers.

cons:

  • depends too much on the community, if one key person pulls their server down it could majorly effect the network, until new servers can be established.

  • having unknown content on a computer in your home.

  • the possibly of man in the middle attacks.

  • having to keep track of all the content, and possibly losing it if we have all the servers with that particular content leave the network.
